text:
maia: FYI started the strict fn-invoke validation canary on /v1/invoke for tool-search at 09:02 PT, seeing immediate spike in rejects and a bunch of fallback routing to generic-text-models
vikram: ugh, how big a spike? can you paste the sample errors?
maia: small sample below, mostly schema mismatch on `results` field (array vs object), and some missing `tool_metadata`
maia: ```json
{"error":"validation_failed","field":"results","expected":"object","got":"array","source":"toolhook"}
{"error":"validation_failed","field":"tool_metadata","expected":"object","got":"null"}
```
sara: is this the new validator logic we rolled last week? thought that was gated in a canary 10%
maia: it is canary 10% but traffic route policy prioritized the canary for a subset of enterprise keys so their traffic is overrepresented in the sample
pranav: that explains the volume. console is showing overall reject rate but not breaking down by model/variant or by route - makes triage slow
alex_r: +1. the dashboard panels only show global 'fncall_rejects' and top-level sample logs. we need per-route and per-model breakdowns (and the canary tag)
vikram: telemetry pipeline currently samples 1% of rejects for full payloads, and the aggregator collapses toolhook metadata to save space. we didn't wire canary metadata through aggregation indexer
maia: can we flip a quick patch to keep canary_label and route_id in the aggregator keys? even without full payloads, counts by (route,model,canary) would help
sara: also quota routing kicked in for some calls. we saw fallback to generic-text causing higher latency and cost. need to correlate quotas->fallbacks in the console
pranav: if quota routing is causing fallbacks, the console should show a chain: request -> reject type (schema|quota) -> final model routed. currently it's two separate charts so you can't join them easily
eng-bot: Canary rollout step: strict-validator v2 enabled for 10% traffic on /v1/invoke at 09:00 PT. Metric emitted: fncall.validator.v2.enabled=true
alex_r: eng-bot logs are good, but we need that flag wired to traces so dashboard can filter traces where fncall.validator.v2.enabled=true
vikram: quick mitigation options: 1) revert strict validator on this route; 2) patch aggregator to emit (route,canary) counts; 3) increase sampling for rejects from 1%->10% for 30m window for affected route
maia: my vote: (2) small aggregator change + (3) transient sampling bump. we can avoid revert and still gather context to triage
sara: I'm fine with (2)+(3). prio: low-risk patch for aggregator first. vikram can you own?
vikram: I can own aggregator change, will push a tiny schema add (canary_label route_id) to the indexer. will open PR now.
pranav: we should also add an alert: if rejects spike > X% AND fallback_rate_to_generic > Y% then page eng-platform. right now only paging for infra SLOs
maia: agreed. and add a dashboard tile: stacked bar - reject_type by route by model variant. that should make the triage fast next time
alex_r: note: need to keep the telemetry change backward compatible; some historical dashboards read the old index. use new field names with fallback to old keys
vikram: yep will include compatibility layer. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/542 (WIP)
maia: thanks. after PR merges i'll flip sampling for 30m for route=tool-search and collect payloads to reproduce failing examples
sara: FYI I'll message the SEs on the enterprise keys so they know we're investigating. :eyes:
maia: thanks. if we see the rejects are mostly due to a downstream adapter sending arrays, we should add a coercion shim in the adapter rather than changing validator immediately
pranav: can we log a sample of offending payloads to the private S3 bucket for replay? need to confirm PII redaction pipeline applies
vikram: will include redaction step. default retention 7d for these sampled rejects
eng-bot: Action created: telemetry/542 - add canary_label to aggregator (assignee: vikram)
maia: closing loop: after we have per-route counts and a few sampled payloads we'll decide revert vs shim. thanks team
vikram: pushing PR to review now, will post updates here
maia: update 09:22 PT - with sampling bump we got 120 rejects samples; 92% are `results` array vs expected object. opening an adapter ticket for search-team
alex_r: nice. can we also add a console link from the validation alert directly to sample logs? cuts lookup time in half
sara: yes please. add to alert runbook too
maia: done. will follow-up with postmortem if needed. :thumbsup:
